metadata.name: heirloom
metadata.description: Heirloom: programmable estate trust holding USDT under strict on-chain rules

accounts.name: agent
docs: The agent; pays rent for the recipient's and buyer's ATAs if missing.

accounts.name: hardship_objection
docs: PDA (address checked in the handler; blocks while Open). Otherwise it is not read: pass
any account, e.g. the system program.

accounts.name: co_signer
docs: A living trusted person other than the buyer and the agent. None only when no seat has a holder, and
then the sale waits for the listing to end.

accounts.name: guard
docs: the objection window before a sale (M8).

accounts.name: hardship_stamp
docs: checked in the handler; it may not exist for a hardship approved before stamps). Otherwise not read: pass
any account, e.g. the system program.

accounts.name: beneficiary
docs: New, or one the owner removed and now adds again.

instructions.name: add_rule_v2
docs: Renamed from add_rule when rule_id became the first argument, so old clients and old programs fail closed.

accounts.name: beneficiary
docs: The Beneficiary PDA the rule is for.

accounts.name: rule
docs: `rule_id` = estate.rule_count for a new slot, or the id of an ended rule whose slot is reused.

accounts.name: payee
docs: Payee PDA for a recurring rule (scheduled payments go to its wallet). Optional: pass the
program id (Anchor's "None") when `recurring_amount == 0`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the ApprovalStamp rent (the verifier or a sponsor).

accounts.name: approval_stamp
docs: ["stamp", claim]: records when the approval threshold was reached (objection window).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the ApprovalStamp rent (the verifier or a sponsor).

accounts.name: approval_stamp
docs: ["stamp", hardship]: when the quorum was reached, so monitors get the objection window before a sale (M8).

accounts.name: confirmer
docs: Holder of another seat (a first backup too, once they hold one). If no other seat has a living holder, or
the approved report has waited the recovery timeout: backups[1] or a monitor of this seat. An active
beneficiary when nobody watches the seat and no other is held, or after the recovery timeout.

accounts.name: beneficiary_account
docs: The confirmer's Beneficiary PDA when a beneficiary confirms; otherwise None.

accounts.name: vault
docs: USD₮ vault = ATA(usdt_mint, estate). init_if_needed so a pre-created ATA can't block setup.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays the payee ATA rent if it doesn't exist yet.

accounts.name: beneficiary_account
docs: The claimant's Beneficiary PDA; must still be active.

accounts.name: payee_account
docs: The Payee PDA of claim.payee; gone once removed.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays the recipient's ATA rent if missing.

accounts.name: objection
docs: (then it is marked Dismissed here, so it is writable).

accounts.name: fallback_report
docs: report made during the countdown holds the payment until it can be confirmed or refuted.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone (a keeper/cron); pays the payee ATA rent if it doesn't exist yet.

accounts.name: beneficiary_account
docs: The rule's Beneficiary PDA; must still be active.

accounts.name: payee_account
docs: The Payee PDA of rule.fixed_payee; gone once removed.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone (any wallet). A signer, so the call can be fee-sponsored (the sponsor is only the fee payer).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone (any wallet). A signer, so the call can be fee-sponsored (the sponsor is only the fee payer).

accounts.name: authority
docs: The owner (estate Active): the waits can't be changed later, so never the agent. Pays rent.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone (any wallet). A signer, so the call can be fee-sponsored (the sponsor is only the fee payer).

accounts.name: authority
docs: The agent or one of the verifiers.

accounts.name: next_seat
docs: way (the owner just made a living trusted person available).

accounts.name: offer_escrow
docs: Offer escrow = ATA(usdt_mint, offer). init_if_needed so a pre-created ATA can't block offers.

accounts.name: disputer
docs: An active beneficiary or one of the estate's verifiers. Pays the rent of a new Objection PDA.

accounts.name: beneficiary_account
docs: The disputer's Beneficiary PDA when a beneficiary disputes; None for a verifier.

accounts.name: guard
docs: place of a monitors' objection that lapsed (L13).

accounts.name: objector
docs: A monitor (of `seat`), or for Fallback also an active beneficiary. Pays rent.

accounts.name: seat
docs: The seat the objector monitors (required unless a beneficiary objects to the fallback).

accounts.name: beneficiary_account
docs: The objector's Beneficiary PDA (Fallback objections by a beneficiary only).

accounts.name: target_account
docs: Pass None for Unlock (target = estate), Succession (target = seat) and Fallback (target = guard).

accounts.name: asset
docs: The hardship's Asset (Hardship objections only).

accounts.name: nft_mint
docs: A title: one of a kind, and nobody can mint another or freeze it.

accounts.name: nft_escrow
docs: NFT escrow = ATA(nft_mint, estate).

accounts.name: asset
docs: Closed to the owner, so the same title can be registered again.

accounts.name: beneficiary_account
docs: The Beneficiary to remove (marked inactive; add_beneficiary brings them back), or None.

accounts.name: payee_account
docs: The Payee to remove (closed to the owner; add_payee brings it back), or None.

accounts.name: seat0
docs: gives way.

accounts.name: reporter
docs: A living trusted person, monitor, active beneficiary or listed recipient. Pays the report's rent.

accounts.name: signer_seat
docs: A seat the reporter monitors; otherwise None.

accounts.name: beneficiary_account
docs: The reporter's Beneficiary PDA; otherwise None.

accounts.name: reporter
docs: A trusted person, the owner, this seat's backup or monitor, or an active beneficiary; never the holder.

accounts.name: beneficiary_account
docs: The reporter's Beneficiary PDA when a beneficiary reports; otherwise None.

accounts.name: verifier
docs: The owner while alive, who decides alone; otherwise a verifier other than the one who raised the dispute.

accounts.name: signer
docs: `dead`: a second participant. Otherwise the reported recipient ("I'm alive").

accounts.name: signer_seat
docs: A seat the signer monitors; otherwise None.

accounts.name: beneficiary_account
docs: The signer's Beneficiary PDA; otherwise None.

accounts.name: seat0
docs: candidate must not be a backup (L9).

accounts.name: authority
docs: The owner, estate Active. Pays rent the first time.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The owner (estate Active) or the seat's current holder.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone (any wallet). A signer, so the call can be fee-sponsored (the sponsor is only the fee payer).

accounts.name: payee
docs: The Payee PDA the money will go to.

accounts.name: beneficiary
docs: An active beneficiary, a living trusted person or a living listed fallback recipient (M10); never the agent.

accounts.name: beneficiary_account
docs: The signer's Beneficiary PDA when a beneficiary submits; otherwise None.

accounts.name: guard
docs: The Guard when a listed fallback recipient submits; otherwise None.

accounts.name: hardship
docs: New, or one the agent rejected (L7): that is not final, an upheld objection is.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays the recipient's ATA rent if missing.

accounts.name: fallback_report
docs: Read only when paying by the fallback list: an agent-approved report on that recipient holds the sweep.

accounts.name: holder
docs: The seat holder: "I'm still here".

accounts.name: seat0
docs: candidate must not be a backup (L9).

accounts.name: voter
docs: A seat holder other than the watched holder and the objector, or the owner while Active
(decides alone). Fallback objections: a monitor other than the objector (one vote, however many seats
they watch).

accounts.name: target_account
docs: None for Unlock (the estate) and Fallback (the guard).

accounts.name: asset
docs: The hardship's Asset (Hardship objections only; its hardship floor is withdrawn if upheld). Refused for
any other kind, so it can't be the target passed twice and overwrite what was written (H1).

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.msg: Signer is not the estate owner

errors.name: NotAgent
errors.msg: Signer is not the estate agent

errors.name: NotVerifier
errors.msg: Signer is not one of the estate verifiers

errors.name: NotBeneficiary
errors.msg: Signer is not an active beneficiary of this estate or rule

errors.name: AlreadyApproved
errors.msg: This verifier has already approved

errors.name: InvalidThreshold
errors.msg: Thresholds must be between 1 and 3 and the waiting period must not be negative

errors.name: DuplicateVerifier
errors.msg: Verifiers must be distinct and must not be the owner

errors.name: BadStatus
errors.msg: The account is not in the right status for this action

errors.name: NoDeathClaim
errors.msg: There is no death claim to act on

errors.name: AgentNotApproved
errors.msg: The agent has not approved this item

errors.name: WaitingPeriodNotOver
errors.msg: The waiting period is not over yet

errors.name: WrongPayeeKind
errors.msg: The payee is not of the kind this rule allows

errors.name: ExceedsPerClaimCap
errors.msg: Amount exceeds the per-claim cap

errors.name: ExceedsLifetimeCap
errors.msg: Amount exceeds the rule's lifetime cap

errors.name: RuleExpired
errors.msg: The rule has expired

errors.name: InsufficientApprovals
errors.msg: Not enough verifier approvals

errors.name: BelowFloor
errors.msg: Offer is below the floor price

errors.name: BelowHardshipFloor
errors.msg: Offer is below the hardship floor

errors.name: ListingClosed
errors.msg: The listing is closed

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Invalid amount

errors.name: InvalidNft
errors.msg: The NFT mint must have 0 decimals and a supply of 1

errors.name: StringTooLong
errors.msg: String is too long

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: Token account or mint does not match the estate's USDT mint

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Math overflow

errors.name: PayeeRequired
errors.msg: A recurring rule needs a payee account

errors.name: NotDue
errors.msg: The scheduled payment is not due yet

errors.name: NotMonitor
errors.msg: Signer is not a monitor allowed to object here

errors.name: ObjectionOpen
errors.msg: An objection is open on this item

errors.name: ObjectionWindowOpen
errors.msg: The objection window is still open

errors.name: SuccessionPending
errors.msg: A succession is already pending for this seat

errors.name: NoSuccessionPending
errors.msg: There is no succession pending for this seat

errors.name: SeatVacant
errors.msg: This seat is vacant

errors.name: SeatsNotVacant
errors.msg: Not every seat is vacant

errors.name: NotConfirmer
errors.msg: Signer may not confirm this death, or it is not confirmed yet

errors.name: FallbackNotReady
errors.msg: The fallback plan is not ready to run

errors.name: FallbackDone
errors.msg: The fallback plan has already run

errors.name: NoFallbackRecipient
errors.msg: No living fallback recipient

errors.name: BadBackup
errors.msg: Invalid backup: must differ from the owner, every trusted person and each other

errors.name: BadMonitor
errors.msg: Invalid monitor: must differ from the holder they watch and from each other

errors.name: BadFallback
errors.msg: Invalid fallback list: recipients must be distinct and not the owner

errors.name: ObjectionLapsed
errors.msg: This fallback objection has lapsed: its waiting period is over

errors.name: ObjectionNotLapsed
errors.msg: This objection cannot lapse yet

errors.name: NotDisputer
errors.msg: Only a beneficiary or a trusted person can dispute

errors.name: DisputeLapsed
errors.msg: This dispute has lapsed: its time to resolve it is over

errors.name: ExceedsYearlyCap
errors.msg: Payment would exceed the rule's cap for this year

errors.name: OwnClaimDispute
errors.msg: You cannot dispute your own claim

errors.name: TimeOutOfRange
errors.msg: That length of time is outside the allowed range

errors.name: TooManyRules
errors.msg: An estate can have at most 16 rules

errors.name: BadAgent
errors.msg: Invalid agent: must be a new wallet that is neither the owner nor a trusted person

errors.name: RulesIncomplete
errors.msg: Every rule of the estate must be passed, in order

errors.name: NoResidualRecipient
errors.msg: The owner did not name anyone to receive what is left

errors.name: NothingToSweep
errors.msg: Nothing is left over: the rules still need what is in the vault

errors.name: ObjectionCooldown
errors.msg: It is too soon to object to this again

errors.name: NotParticipant
errors.msg: Signer is not one of the people who may report or refute this

errors.name: OwnApproval
errors.msg: You cannot approve or dismiss in your own favour

errors.name: CoSignerRequired
errors.msg: A living trusted person who is neither the buyer nor the agent must co-sign this sale

errors.name: ListingStillOpen
errors.msg: With no trusted people left, a sale waits for the listing to end

errors.name: InvalidWallet
errors.msg: A real wallet is required

errors.name: ReportChanged
errors.msg: The report changed since it was read

errors.name: DeathReportOpen
errors.msg: A reported death of this recipient is waiting to be confirmed

errors.name: ClaimFromEndedRule
errors.msg: The claim belongs to a rule that was ended and replaced

errors.name: OfferChanged
errors.msg: The offer is no longer the amount that was agreed

errors.name: DeathDisproved
errors.msg: The owner showed life after this death claim was made

errors.name: OfferTooOld
errors.msg: This offer was made before an objection to the sale was upheld

types.name: AgentReviewCleared
docs: A review by an agent that has since been replaced was set back to Pending: the new agent reviews it again.
`target` is the estate (its death claim), a Seat or a FallbackReport.

types.name: AgentVote
docs: Seeds: ["agentvote", estate, candidate]. The trusted people's votes to replace a lost agent key.

fields.name: replaces
docs: The agent these votes replace; they are void once it is no longer the agent.

fields.name: voters
docs: The wallet that voted from each seat; counts only while it still holds that seat.

types.name: ApprovalStamp
docs: Seeds: ["stamp", target]. Written by approve_claim; `approved_at` is set when the threshold is reached.

fields.name: approved_at
docs: 0 = threshold not reached yet. Until it is, `seat_index` is NO_SEAT: the approvals being collected
were all given after the unlock.

types.name: Asset
docs: Seeds: ["asset", estate, nft_mint]

types.name: AssetMedia
docs: Seeds: ["media", asset]

fields.name: photos_root
docs: SHA-256 of the concatenated photo hashes, in display order.

types.name: Beneficiary
docs: Seeds: ["beneficiary", estate, wallet]

types.name: Claim
docs: Seeds: ["claim", rule, id.to_le_bytes() (u32)]

fields.name: beneficiary
docs: Beneficiary wallet.

fields.name: payee
docs: Payee wallet.

fields.name: approvals
docs: Bitmap: verifier i sets bit 1 << i.

fields.name: owner_approved
docs: Set by `owner_approve_claim` (living plans, estate Active): replaces the verifier quorum.

fields.name: count
docs: Number of attestations so far.

fields.name: pending
docs: True once the estate is DeathPending (threshold reached).

types.name: Estate
docs: Seeds: ["estate", owner]

fields.name: death_attestations
docs: Bitmap: verifier i sets bit 1 << i.

fields.name: death_pending_since
docs: While Active with a death claim: when it was submitted. Afterwards: when the quorum confirmed it.
Read the state from `status` and `death_cert_hash`, never from this being non-zero.

types.name: FallbackReport
docs: Seeds: ["fallbackreport", estate, &[index]]. An open report that fallback recipient `index` died. Closed,
with the rent going back to `rent_payer`, when it is rejected, refuted or confirmed.

fields.name: recipient
docs: The recipient reported; the report is void once the list names someone else there.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who created the account. A report that replaces it never takes over the rent.

types.name: Guard
docs: Seeds: ["guard", estate]. One per estate; its existence switches on windows and objections.

fields.name: objection_window_secs
docs: Claims: delay between reaching the approval threshold and execute.

fields.name: fallback
docs: Ordered fallback recipients (wallets); default = unused.

fields.name: fallback_dead
docs: Bitmap: recipient i proven dead sets bit 1 << i.

fields.name: fallback_started_at
docs: 0 = not started.

types.name: Hardship
docs: Seeds: ["hardship", asset, beneficiary_wallet]

fields.name: beneficiary
docs: Beneficiary wallet.

fields.name: approvals
docs: Bitmap: verifier i sets bit 1 << i.

fields.name: quorum_reached
docs: True once the quorum is reached and the hardship floor applies.

fields.name: payee
docs: True for a payee, false for a beneficiary.

types.name: Objection
docs: Seeds: ["objection", target]. One per target; a resolved one can be re-raised (overwritten).

fields.name: seat_index
docs: Seat being watched (NO_SEAT = 255 for Unlock / Fallback).

fields.name: votes_uphold
docs: Bitmaps: seat i sets 1 << i (Fallback: monitor j of seat i sets 1 << (2i + j)).

types.name: Offer
docs: Seeds: ["offer", asset, buyer]

types.name: Payee
docs: Seeds: ["payee", estate, wallet]

types.name: Residual
docs: Seeds: ["residual", estate]. Who receives what no live rule still needs after the unlock.

types.name: ReviewOutcome
docs: The agent's answer to review_death, review_claim and review_hardship. The first two values encode
like the bool they replace.

types.name: Rule
docs: Seeds: ["rule", estate, id.to_le_bytes() (u16)]

fields.name: beneficiary
docs: Beneficiary wallet (not the Beneficiary PDA).

fields.name: starts_now
docs: Living plan: claims (and scheduled payments) work while the estate is still Active.

fields.name: recurring_amount
docs: Scheduled payment per interval; 0 = not recurring.

fields.name: next_due
docs: Unix time the next scheduled payment may be executed.

fields.name: fixed_payee
docs: Payee wallet of the scheduled payment; Pubkey::default() = none.

fields.name: first_claim_id
docs: Claims with a lower id belong to the ended rule and can never pay.

types.name: Seat
docs: Seeds: ["seat", estate, &[index]] (index 0..3, mirrors estate.verifiers[index]).

fields.name: holder
docs: Always == estate.verifiers[index]; Pubkey::default() when vacant.

fields.name: monitors
docs: Set by the owner only; survive succession.

fields.name: generation
docs: +1 on every succession or owner replacement.

fields.name: vacant
docs: Holder proven dead and no backup left.

fields.name: death_pending_since
docs: When the death was reported; once `death_confirmed_by` is set, when it was confirmed (the succession wait
runs from there).

types.name: SeatApproval
docs: A seat holder approved something (claim, unlock attestation, hardship). Monitors are notified from this.

types.name: SeatConfigured
docs: Emitted by init_seat, set_seat_backups, set_seat_monitors and owner_replace_seat.

types.name: SeatDeathReportCleared
docs: A seat's death report was cleared for a fresh one: it could not promote anyone who reported or confirmed it,
the owner removed who confirmed it or gave an unwatched seat a monitor, or it was stale and gave way to new
backups.

types.name: YearCap
docs: Seeds: ["yearcap", rule]. Optional per-rule cap per 365-day period, on top of the per-claim and
lifetime caps. Claims and scheduled payments under the rule add to `period_spent`.

fields.name: cap
docs: Most that may be paid under the rule per period (base units).

fields.name: period_start
docs: Start of the current period; rolls forward by whole periods.

fields.name: period_spent
docs: Paid in the period that starts at `period_start`.
